title: Advance bookings and Blanche running the business
summary: Societies booked Laine's band months ahead; after he married in 1894/95 his wife kept the dates and contracts.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: Yeah. Sounded pretty good to me. It sounded to everybody because I'll quickly tell you. When I organized the band, it seems like, I don't know whether they liked the music or not, but it engaged me three, four, and five months ahead of time to play music for them. I prayed for the ladies of Violet from down below. Oh, that's a long time ago. I prayed for them. They used to have Chief British Band. Always prayed. And I prayed for them. They come to me about six months before they gave their affair. Is that right? And they engaged the band.
You must have made quite a bit of money out of that then in those days, right?
Now, after I was married, you understand, she used to run the business for me. I wouldn't be home. I'd be out.
What year were you all married?
All kinds of contracts for me. And she knew just... 94.
She just knew the dates I had and didn't know the dates I didn't have. She killed them dates.
